traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.text: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +8, reach 5 ft. _Hit:_ 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

actions.name: Mind-Rending Roar (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text: _Wisdom Saving Throw:_ DC 16, each enemy in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. _Failure:_ 35 (10d6) Psychic damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.text:
The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16):
 **At Will:** _Detect Magic_, _Identify_, _Mage Hand_, _Minor Illusion_, _Prestidigitation_
 **1/Day Each:** _Dispel Magic_, _Legend Lore_, _Locate Object_, _Plane Shift_, _Remove Curse_, _Tongues_

legendaryActions.text: _Legendary Action Uses: 3 (4 in Lair). Immediately after another creature's turn, the sphinx can expend a use to take one of the following actions. The sphinx regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns._

legendaryActions.name: Arcane Prowl
legendaryActions.text: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendaryActions.name: Weight of Years
legendaryActions.text: _Constitution Saving Throw:_ DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. _Failure:_ The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. _Failure or Success:_ The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.
